name: John H. Watson
source:
An exchanged professor at Yumei University.
[SPOILER]
He was a member of "Death God of the Old Bailey". He falsified the autopsy on the body of Klint. Then, he became a victim of an exchange murder by Vortex's planning. He is not the father of Iris Watson.
